name: Style Switcher
description: Allows website visitors to choose which stylesheet they would like to view the site with.
project_description:
Allows website visitors to choose which stylesheet they would like to view the site with.

 Click a link » get the new look of the site.

 
 The module takes the fuss out of creating themes or building sites with alternate stylesheets.

 
 Themer can provide a theme with alternate stylesheets. 
 Site builder can add other alternate stylesheets in the admin section. 
 
 And this module presents all those styles to site visitors as a list of links in a block. So any site visitor is able to choose the style of the site they prefer. The module uses cookies so that when people return to the site or visit a different page they still get their chosen style.

 For more information about the module, including its step-by-step configuration and different use cases, check the README.txt file in release packages or visit the documentation guide .

 There is a demo profile which can be used to see how the module works, and to test the module.
